products.label: C
products.reason: Space situational awareness uses similar space sensing technology, but it targets a broader and somewhat different use case than the prior navigation, docking, and star-sensing products.

products.label: D
products.reason: Miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR is the same LiDAR sensor family already offered for rendezvous, docking, and 3D pose estimation.

products.label: E
products.reason: This matches the previously offered compact radiation-hard space camera almost exactly.

products.label: F
products.reason: An asteroid navigation and imaging camera builds on the firm’s spacecraft navigation and imaging camera technology, but applies it to a more specialized mission context.
